countingPolicy: Count character IDs only; exclude 77 terrain IDs. Standard-body trial assets remain references and are not added as 10 extra completions; avoid double counting. Restored means original binary blobs exist and have been copied, not final visual acceptance.

requirements.proportionReference: art/rebuild-skeletons/bases/human.png and human-mounted.png are immutable anatomy references; do not derive proportions from newly generated dressed characters.
requirements.proportionGate: Judge generated output, not prompt text: compare anatomical skull-crown to chin, shoulder, pelvis, knee, ankle and sole positions with immutable original skeleton. Exclude hair/helmet/crest/beard/weapon. Human exactly FIVE heads; reject four or six-plus. Riders judged as human anatomy separately from horse. Preserve pixel style and elevated front camera.
requirements.headPose: 전체적으로 기존처럼 고개를 살짝 숙여 턱과 시선은 앞쪽 아래; 정수리 노출. 턱 들기·정면 응시 금지.
requirements.cameraGate: Actual elevated-front reprojection of whole rider and horse; crown, shoulder tops, horse withers and saddle top visible. Do not substitute chin tuck or head-size-only edits for camera elevation.
requirements.motionAndSilhouette: 기존의 동세·기승 자세·실루엣·숙인 고개를 우선 보존. 비율 통일을 이유로 획일적인 정면 자세로 바꾸지 않는다. 기존보다 멋/완성도/가독성이 떨어지면 불합격 또는 기존 유지.
